# Candy Crush Ultra - AI Context

## Overview
Candy Crush Ultra is a premium, purely static, local-first Match-3 puzzle game. It uses zero backend compute, storing all progression (199 levels) locally using OPFS/IndexedDB.

## Architecture
- Frontend: React 18, Next.js 15 (SSG)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion
- Storage: idb-keyval (Local-First OPFS fallback)
- Deployment: Pure Static Files (Cloudflare Pages), zero Workers.

## SEO Structure
- 30+ Location Pages to capture local search intent
- Programmatic Feature pages
- Fully pre-rendered HTML

## Key Differentiators
- 100% Free, no paywalls
- 0 ads
- Zero latency
